rules.rationale: Heavily halogenated scaffolds are the classic high-logD chemotype; a small, chemically distinctive subset.
Halogen-free molecules lack a principal hydrophobic substituent contribution to logD.
Dense heteroatom loading adds hydrogen-bonding and desolvation cost, opposing the positive source donor relation.
Aromatic carbon surface remains the mechanistically safest positive lipophilicity term across chemotypes.
